name: Dabble
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Dabble, plan chapters, draft a manuscript, track plot threads, and sync a structured writing project. The hard boundary is cloud sync, mobile access, goals, and polished manuscript organization, plus polish, integrations, and proprietary language models.
